data.name: AlBadawi
data.gender_notes: AlBadawi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who has performed the Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca. The name AlBadawi carries the meaning “Pilgrim” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlBadawi usually hope their child will grow to embody pilgrim and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlBadawi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "AlBadawi" holds a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. It signifies that the person bearing this name has completed the Hajj pilgrimage, one of the five pillars of Islam. This pilgrimage is a pious journey to the holiest city in Islam, Mecca, which every Muslim is encouraged to undertake at least once in a lifetime. The AlBadawi title brings a sense of immense respect and reverence from the Muslim community, a testament to the individual's dedication to their faith. This title represents a strong connection to the Islamic faith and its traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "AlBadawi" goes beyond just the pilgrimage to Mecca. It symbolizes a deep commitment to the Islamic faith, a growing relationship with Allah, and a journey towards self-improvement and spiritual enrichment. The Hajj pilgrimage isn't just about crossing off a bucket list item, but about seeking forgiveness, gaining inner peace, and strengthening one's bond with Allah. The name AlBadawi, therefore, represents the individual's ongoing spiritual evolution and devotion to their faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Pilgrim" symbolizes A person who has performed the Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name AlBadawi serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of pilgrim.
